spans.label: Imported plonky2 and cyclic verifier-data helpers
spans.note: `use` lines pull in plonky2 builder/proof APIs, the Poseidon and keccak gadgets and the typed limb traits. The model treats all of them as opaque callbacks or premises; no lowering is proved.

spans.label: BLOCK_CHAIN_PUBLIC_INPUTS_LEN
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; the 2 * 48 public-input width is pinned as a literal.

spans.label: BlockChainPublicInputsError variants
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; the length and per-field parse failures are modeled by the shared Fault type.

spans.label: BlockChainPublicInputs fields
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; the two extended states are modeled structurally and the VerifierOnlyCircuitData is kept as an opaque word list.

spans.label: Comment, attribute or whitespace
spans.note: Read-only source commentary, derive/where attribute or closing brace; prose is not promoted to an executable guarantee.

spans.label: BlockChainPublicInputs::to_u64_vec
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; the concatenation order initial-state, state, verifier-data and the resulting width are modeled.

spans.label: BlockChainPublicInputs::from_u64_slice
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; the exact expected length (96 + vd_vec_len), the cursor order and the two range-checked extended-state parses are modeled. The verifier-data reconstruction itself is opaque.

spans.label: BlockChainPublicInputsTarget fields
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; the target carries the same three components.

spans.label: Target allocation of the two states and the verifier data
spans.note: add_virtual_verifier_data and the checked ExtendedPublicStateTarget allocation are plonky2 boundaries.

spans.label: BlockChainPublicInputsTarget::to_vec
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; the in-circuit encoding is the same list as the native one.

spans.label: BlockChainPublicInputsTarget::from_pis
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; the `>=` length assertion is modeled as a panic and the split as pure prefix arithmetic. Trailing public inputs of the inner proof are dropped without constraint and nothing is range-checked here.

spans.label: BlockChainPublicInputsTarget::set_witness
spans.note: Witness assignment, including set_verifier_data_target, is a plonky2 boundary.

spans.label: Connecting the two extended public states
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; the two ExtendedPublicStateTarget::connect calls are field-wise equality and therefore pin both states.

spans.label: builder.connect_verifier_data
spans.note: Merkle-cap and circuit-digest equality of two VerifierCircuitTargets is a plonky2 boundary; the model only compares opaque word lists.

boundaries.name: cyclic_verifier_data
boundaries.obligation: vd_vec_len / vd_to_vec / vd_from_pis_slice and connect_verifier_data are modeled as an opaque word list of length 4 + 4*cap_elements. The Merkle-cap and circuit-digest semantics, and check_cyclic_proof_verifier_data, are not modeled.

boundaries.name: target_parser_panics
boundaries.obligation: The in-circuit from_pis assertion denotes a build-time panic, not a constraint; a short public-input vector is a compile failure, and an over-long one silently loses its tail. No refinement to Rust panic semantics is proved.

boundaries.name: extended_state_parse
boundaries.obligation: The two per-state parses inherit the ext_public_state.rs boundaries (Poseidon commitment, target range allocation).

boundaries.name: native_target_refinement
boundaries.obligation: No proof relates the handwritten model to the Rust source or to the plonky2 gate lowering.
